title: Artificial Intelligence Final Examination — Multiple Choice Questions
instructions: Choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.

questions.question: What is the primary goal of supervised learning?

options.A: To find hidden patterns in unlabeled data
options.B: To learn a mapping from inputs to outputs using labeled training data
options.C: To maximize a reward signal through trial and error
options.D: To reduce the dimensionality of a dataset

questions.question: Which algorithm is commonly used for classification tasks and works by finding a hyperplane that best separates classes?
In a neural network, what is the purpose of an activation function?

options.A: To initialize the weights of the network
options.B: To normalize the input data before training
options.C: To introduce non-linearity so the network can learn complex patterns
options.D: To reduce the number of layers needed

questions.question: What does the term 'overfitting' refer to in machine learning?

options.A: A model that performs well on training data but poorly on unseen data
options.B: A model that is too simple to capture patterns in the data
options.C: A model that trains too quickly
options.D: A model that uses too little training data

questions.question: Which search algorithm is guaranteed to find the shortest path in a weighted graph with non-negative edge weights?
What is the main idea behind reinforcement learning?

options.A: An agent learns by receiving rewards or penalties for its actions in an environment
options.B: A model is trained using only labeled examples
options.C: Data is grouped into clusters based on similarity
options.D: Features are reduced to a smaller set of variables

questions.question: In the context of AI, what does 'NLP' stand for?
Which of the following is a common technique used to prevent overfitting in neural networks?
What is the primary function of a convolutional layer in a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)?

options.A: To extract spatial features such as edges and textures from images
options.B: To convert text into numerical vectors
options.C: To store the final classification output

questions.question: The Turing Test was proposed to evaluate what property of a machine?

options.B: Its ability to exhibit intelligent behavior indistinguishable from a human
